# vantage_ingest_token (Resource)

Manages an ingest token. The secret is returned only at creation and is stored in Terraform state. Destroying the resource revokes the token. Changes to configuration replace it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vantage_ingest_token" "example" {
  feed_token     = "srvc_data_intgrtn_example"
  name           = "Production"
  retention_days = 30
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `feed_token` (String) Public token of the telemetry feed.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) Expiration in RFC3339 format with whole-second precision. Must be in the future and within 18 calendar months of creation. Defaults to 18 months after creation.
- `name` (String) Non-empty name with no leading or trailing whitespace.
- `retention_days` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `created_by` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `issued_at` (String)
- `last4` (String)
- `plaintext_token` (String, Sensitive) Secret credential, returned only at creation and stored in Terraform state.
- `telemetry_provider` (String)
- `token` (String)
